evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked — call is an existing-booking confirmation/refinement call.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised a string of real questions (bag packing, minimum hours, truck size, couch disassembly, borrowing blankets, TV protection, damage-coverage cost, overage pricing) and the rep worked through every single one to full resolution.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'It is just prorated for the fifteen minute increments... if it took two hours and 45 minutes you would just pay that $50 difference... you don't have to pay for a four hour if you're only going to use like 30 minutes extra.'

top_strength: Exceptional patience and thoroughness answering a long string of detailed pre-move questions (blankets, TV protection, overage billing math) without ever rushing the customer or losing the thread.
coaching_note: Meet Your Mover and both Stage 2 takeaway differentiators (On-Time Guarantee, Communication) were never mentioned anywhere in a 10+ minute call packed with rapport — a clear, correctable gap since there was clearly time and openness for it.
grading_notes: Judgment calls: (1) stage3_estimate scored partial (5) since the core anchor ('typical X takes Y hours') appears to have been established on an earlier call — this call only refines/reconfirms it with added furniture, so full personalization credit felt too generous; (2) stage3_close scored full credit (5) since this is an already-booked confirmation call with no natural rate-lock/explicit-ask moment.
